answer: Each agent must post a bond that is locked before it can submit work, and the bond is slashed when independent audits show fabricated results or collusion. Because creating many identities requires funding a separate bond for each one, a sybil attacker ties up real capital and risks losing it; a cheap ivory, cedar, or dune-themed profile gains no extra trust by itself. Reputation accrues only through verified contributions, so splitting one actor across accounts does not multiply earned credibility.
